note.after_visit_summary: You have a bladder infection, also called acute cystitis. We found burning when you urinate, needing to go often, and pressure in your lower belly. Your urine test showed signs of infection. We are starting you on an antibiotic called nitrofurantoin. Take 100 mg by mouth twice a day for 5 days, and take it with food to avoid stomach upset. You may continue taking the AZO for urinary pain for one more day only. Drink plenty of water. We sent a urine sample to the lab to confirm the infection and check which antibiotic works best; results will be ready in 2 to 3 days. If the lab shows the antibiotic needs to be changed, we will call you. Call us the same day if you get fever, back or side pain, or vomiting, as this could mean the infection is spreading. Also call if you are not feeling better in 2 to 3 days. Otherwise, no follow-up visit is needed. We will reach you at 555-0118 if we need to contact you.
